kind: garden map interaction with a disclosed mixed-ownership save fixture
checks: Mixed-ownership save fixture: preview marks 11/12/13/14, matches each row to the map, explains enemy and mortgaged plots, changes no gameplay state and has no overlapping number labels.
Real ¥300 conversion refreshes the map from hypothetical to active, with current rent and exact contribution; opening the map from the ledger closes the modal.
Closing and reopening removes old marks and labels, restores the camera and never accumulates duplicate geometry.
At 390px map numbers remain separated, the explanation is below the board with no horizontal overflow, and the close button stays reachable after scrolling a long ledger.
Reload retains the real park and property ownership, starts with the optional view closed, and reopening recomputes the same active influence without new save fields.

Actual canvas clicks select the matching numbered plot; rotation keeps labels apart; ordinary property details show ¥1140 current rent including ¥190 garden contribution and link back to that map selection.
Starting an ordinary dice action automatically closes the inspection view and restores the normal scene without blocking the turn.
